mechanism.claim: A dated CFTC enforcement action is an irregular derivatives-risk attention shock. When BTC is already in a high realized-variation state, the completed pre-publication 24-hour direction should persist as leveraged participants continue repricing regulatory and counterparty risk for another twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of BTCUSDT log return over exact [decision-24h,decision)
mechanism.why_distinct: CEVMR uses the complete official CFTC enforcement-action archive only as an irregular exogenous attention clock and uses no action-text sentiment, crypto keyword filter, scheduled macro clock, Gross9 event set, prior terminal source, or diagnostic control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: prior-24h realized variation at the action date must rank in its strict-prior upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: CFTC action dates are irregular and sparse; date-only records enter at a conservative 22:05 UTC

authority.record: official dated CFTC enforcement action or order linked by the archive
authority.historical_identity: preserve archive page bytes, action link, displayed date, title, and document link; no search-engine date
authority.availability: 22:00 UTC on displayed date because no authoritative intraday release time is frozen

features.btc_window: exact 1440 BTCUSDT bars_binance 1m rows [decision-24h,decision), finite coherent positive OHLC, no imputation
features.direction: log(last completed 1m close/first 1m open), strict nonzero
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank at all valid CFTC action dates, at most 252, minimum 126, current excluded, >=0.65
features.same_date: multiple actions deduplicate to one clock; action URLs sorted and hash-bound

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

research_boundary.selection_basis: new irregular CFTC enforcement attention clock with causal high-volatility momentum

stopping_rule: terminal first failure: archive integrity/support, Gross9 novelty, sequential economics; no archive year, event type, time, volatility, side, hold, or subset repair
